items.title: We could not be prouder of our squad! 💙💛
body: Our Trident Development Squad took on their very first AGC competition of the season — and the smiles said it all. Big routines, big nerves, and even bigger cheers for each other all day long.
Watching them walk out beaming (with a 2nd overall finish to boot!) made us so proud of every single one of them. Huge congratulations, team — the best of luck for the rest of the season. Go Trident!
